question: Suryakumar Yadav is associated with which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Suryakumar Yadav on 6th Nov 2022 became the first Indian player to score 1,000 T20 International runs in a calendar year.
 
• He accomplished this feat in India's final Super 12 stage match against Zimbabwe in Melbourne.
 
• He scored 61 not out of 25 balls, consisting of six fours and four sixes.
 
• In 28 innings this year, Suryakumar has scored 1,026 runs at an average of 44.60.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Important Current Affairs related to Cricket in 2022:

 
 
• Rohit Sharma on 2 Oct 2022 became the first player from the country to feature in 400 T20 matches.
 
• Bangladesh pacer Rubel Hossain on 19 Sept 2022 announced his retirement from Test cricket.
 
• Bangladesh wicketkeeper-batter and former captain, Mushfiqur Rahim on 4 September 2022 announced his retirement from T20 internationals.
 
• In England, the Leicester Cricket Ground has been named after India's legendary cricketer, Sunil Gavaskar.
 
• West Indies cricketers Denesh Ramdin and Lendl Simmons have announced their retirement from international cricket.
 
• England all-rounder Ben Stokes has announced his retirement from one-day internationals (ODIs).
 
• India pacer Mohammed Shami has become the fastest Indian to take 150 wickets in One Day Internationals (ODIs).
